'''Xeric's Shrine''' is a temple housed north-east of [[Mount Quidamortem]], north of the [[Lizardman Settlement]] in the [[Kebos Lowlands]].

Players can recharge their [[prayer points]] at the [[altar]] in this location. The [[Swamp Priest]] lives right outside the shrine.

It is also the location for the third hole you climb into during the [[The Garden of Death]] quest.

It's recommended to bring [[antipoison]] potions while moving through this area since the [[lizardmen]] can [[poison]] you.
